description: Send a FILE into a persistent channel as a first-class `file` message. Base64 bytes → Storage → message-send.

file_base64.description: Attachment bytes as base64 (or a data: URL). MCP is JSON-only, so binary is base64-encoded. Max ~15 MB decoded.

mime.description: MIME type, e.g. audio/ogg, application/pdf, image/png.

reply_to_id.description: Optional id of the message being replied to.

name: mIRC_send_file
